en.title: Britain Returns 12 Lost Cultural Relics and Artworks to China
en.summary: Britain handed over 12 cultural relics and artworks to China in a ceremony held at the Chinese embassy in London on September 23, with attendance from Chinese and British officials.

en.title: 2026 Zhengzhou Marathon: Four Elements Help Central Plains Culture "Run" Into the Race
en.summary: The 2026 Zhengzhou Marathon, scheduled for October 18 with a theme celebrating Central Plains culture, will feature 25,000 participants across marathon and half-marathon categories.

en.title: Weight Loss Keeps Failing? Don't Overlook Hidden Fats in Your Meals
en.summary: Hidden dietary fats that are difficult to detect despite being labeled as healthy or light may be preventing weight loss despite controlling portions and exercising.

stories.title: 四集人文纪录片《四季新疆》以四时山河绘就新时代新疆人文长卷

en.title: Four-Episode Humanistic Documentary "Four Seasons of Xinjiang" Depicts New Era Xinjiang Through Seasonal Landscapes
en.summary: A four-episode documentary produced by Xinjiang Broadcasting and Television will air from September 27 to 30, blending natural scenery with everyday life to portray contemporary Xinjiang.

en.title: Chinese and British Youth Share Stage, Using Qinqiang Opera as Bridge to Find Common Ground
en.summary: Students and teachers from a Northern Ireland school visited Beijing and participated in a cultural exchange event where they experienced Qinqiang opera alongside Chinese students, exploring shared cultural understanding through theatrical interaction.

en.summary: Hainan University announced plans to promote philosophy and social science development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period to better support the construction of a free trade port.

en.title: Henan-Taiwan Workers Mid-Autumn Festival Gathering Held in Zhengzhou, Henan
en.summary: A Mid-Autumn Festival social event for Henan and Taiwan workers took place in Zhengzhou on September 23rd, bringing together labor models, craftspeople, Taiwan compatriots, and Taiwan enterprise employees.

en.title: Chinese team wins men's 10-meter air pistol team gold at Asian Games
en.summary: At the Nagoya Asian Games on September 24, China's men's 10-meter air pistol team comprising Hu Kai, Xie Yu, and Bu Shuaihang claimed the gold medal in the team final.

en.title: Limited-time equity prices 229,900-291,900 yuan, five-seat SUV Qijing GX7 officially launches
en.summary: Qijing GX7 launched on September 23 with three versions priced between 229,900 and 291,900 yuan. Celebrities attended the release event to share experiences with the five-seat SUV.

stories.title: Hong Kong police search for woman after man found dead outside commercial building

en.title: Hong Kong police search for woman after man found dead outside commercial building
en.summary: Hong Kong police are searching for a Chinese woman after discovering a man's body at a Tsim Sha Tsui commercial building. A 28-year-old bar staff member was arrested and charged with illegally handling a corpse after admitting to helping move the body.

en.title: Xi Jinping: Finding the right way for two major powers to coexist in the new era
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington on September 23 for a state visit at President Trump's invitation. Xi and his wife were warmly received by Trump and his wife upon arrival at Andrews Air Force Base.

stories.title: 成都中欧班列集结中心已在全省市、州布局10个组货基地

en.title: Chengdu China-Europe Railway Express Collection Center has established 10 cargo consolidation bases across the province
en.summary: Chengdu's China-Europe Railway Express Collection Center established its tenth provincial cargo consolidation base in Ya'an on September 23. This expansion enhances the collection center's role in coordinating freight services between the China-Europe railway express and the Western Land-Sea New Corridor.

stories.title: 1,700% share surge for Chinese state-owned compressor maker exposes risks of new listings

en.title: 1,700% share surge for Chinese state-owned compressor maker exposes risks of new listings
en.summary: ShenGu Group, a Chinese state-owned compressor manufacturer, saw its stock surge over 1,700 percent following its Shanghai Stock Exchange listing, prompting the bourse to intervene against speculative trading.

stories.title: China has scrapped two-thirds of its planned coal power plants abroad: report

en.title: China has scrapped two-thirds of its planned coal power plants abroad: report
en.summary: China's state sector has cancelled two-thirds of its previously planned overseas coal power projects, eliminating 61.5 gigawatts of capacity and preventing substantial carbon emissions, though private projects continue.

en.title: How China's growing Reit sector is giving foreign property investors a route back in
en.summary: Foreign investors are gradually returning to China's commercial property market through domestic real estate investment trusts, attracted by lower asset prices and improved financing conditions, though their participation remains limited.

stories.title: Hong Kong rises in property market transparency rankings, but trails Singapore and Japan

en.title: Hong Kong rises in property market transparency rankings, but trails Singapore and Japan
en.summary: Hong Kong improved to 14th place in the Global Real Estate Transparency Index, climbing one position but remaining behind regional competitors Singapore and Japan.

stories.title: Trump offloads tens of millions in AI, tech shares, led by Microsoft, Amazon, Meta

en.title: Trump offloads tens of millions in AI, tech shares, led by Microsoft, Amazon, Meta
en.summary: US President Trump sold tens of millions of dollars in shares of major technology companies including Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta in July. Microsoft represented the largest portion of sales with six transactions totaling approximately 31 million dollars.
